opinions.text:
On petition for writ of cer-tiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the *944Third Circuit. Dismissed per stipulation pursuant to Rule 60 of the Rules of this Court.

Dean Acheson was on the stipulation for petitioners. With him on the petition were Stanley L. Temko and Warren M. Sparks. John H. Poe was on the stipulation for respondent. With him on a brief in opposition was David F. Anderson.
